title: Fuzzy spec
skill: State the rules before the agent starts

good: Implement slugify(title) in slug.py with these exact rules: 1) lowercase; 2) turn accented letters into plain ASCII letters (Café -> cafe) with unicodedata NFKD and drop what is left; 3) any run of characters that are not a-z or 0-9 becomes one hyphen; 4) no hyphen at the start or end; 5) at most 50 characters: keep the longest run of whole words that fits, and if the first word alone is longer than 50, cut it at 50; 6) if the result is empty, return "post". Only change slug.py. Then run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v
lazy: Implement slugify properly for blog URLs.
